Participants

Source: R/participants.R
gorilla_participants.Rd

One row per participant, with the identifiers, the status, the device, operating system and browser, and the times of the first and last recorded event. tasks counts the tasks and questionnaires the participant has data for. The outcome of each randomiser, branch and checkpoint node follows, and then the last value of each store field. Columns that are empty for all participants are dropped.

Usage

gorilla_participants(x, status = NULL)

Arguments

x

A gorilla_data object from read_gorilla().

status

Keep only participants with these values of participant_status, such as "complete". All by default.

Value

A tibble. start and end are in UTC; minutes is the time between them.

Examples

g <- read_gorilla(gorilla_example())
#> Skipped 1 file without data (nodes no participant reached): data_exp_123456-v3_questionnaire-zz1e.csv
gorilla_participants(g)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 18
#>   participant_private_id participant_public_id    experiment_id

#> 1 9100037                c805ceab3f4eb9172ecd0b95        123456

#> 3 9100111                b48c18f6af1d44ac3fe078e2        123456
#> 4 9100148                cce8638538eef07b5c3ce7a5        123456
#> 5 9100185                7f50b2600354023e074434c0        123456
#> 6 9100222                9b2d42c0a5c131039b4134ea        123456
